sections.label: THE ANSWER
sections.rule: Identify the registered owner only from the relevant title evidence.

sections.label: WHAT THE FOLIO SHOWS
sections.rule: Explain registered ownership and registered interests supported by the folio.

sections.label: WHAT THE FOLIO DOES NOT ANSWER
sections.rule: Identify questions requiring filed instruments, historical searches, boundary evidence or other sources.

sections.label: TITLE EVIDENCE
sections.rule: Distinguish folio, filed plan, underlying instruments and official searches.

sections.label: DATE
sections.rule: State the date or period for which the ownership position has been established.

sections.label: OFFICIAL ROUTE
sections.rule: Link to the appropriate Tailte Éireann search/copy/registration service.

guardrails: Do not infer registered ownership from an address alone.
Do not treat a folio as answering every legal title question.
Do not treat a registry map as automatically conclusive of physical boundaries.
Public-record accessibility does not remove the need for privacy analysis when republishing data.
